title: knowledge-sources-fuzzing: artifact for "Where Does an LLM Fuzzer's Domain Knowledge Come From?"
description:
Research artifact for the paper Where Does an LLM Fuzzer's Domain Knowledge Come From? Human, Code-Read, and Self-Acquired Knowledge for Differential Testing of Typed Deserializers (preprint: 10.5281/zenodo.23002933).

A pre-registered study of where an LLM-guided differential fuzzer's domain knowledge comes from: none, a human characterization, a code-reading agent, or a black-box probing agent, compared under a fixed refinement loop on four Dart and four Kotlin JSON deserialization paths, with a pre-registered extension testing systematic probing and a larger prober. Contains the design and deviations log, the Kotlin four-library harness, the refinement loop and knowledge agents, every prompt, response, generated document and knowledge summary (55 runs, 83,500 documents, 600 probes), the analysis scripts, the Kotlin divergence triage and the LaTeX source of the paper.
